acceptance.given: An isolated corrupt-fact fixture is evaluated with all non-corrupt inputs held constant.

oracle.expected: The evaluation terminates unsuccessfully with an explicit unknown-fact rejection and no successful result.
forbidden: Processing continues after the unknown fact
A successful result is emitted for the corrupt fact
oracle.observable: A test result artifact records the corrupt-fact input, terminal unsuccessful status, and unknown-fact rejection reason.

acceptance.then: Run the isolated corrupt-fact evaluation and inspect its terminal result.
acceptance.when: An unknown fact is encountered during evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate unknown-fact handling so processing continues or a successful result is emitted, then run the corrupt-fact selector and require the terminal fail-closed assertion to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure unknown facts produce an unsuccessful terminal evaluation rather than continued processing or success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing disposition/result schema and fail-closed status semantics; rollback only unknown-fact handling.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evaluation result is terminal and unsuccessful with unknown-fact rejection recorded.

acceptance.given: An isolated absent-path fixture changes only the target path from the valid baseline.

oracle.expected: The target path is rejected as invalid-input and an independent witness artifact is produced.
forbidden: Any non-target input differs from the baseline
The contract is claimed without an independent witness
oracle.observable: A fixture-specific test artifact records the absent path, invalid-input rejection, unchanged companion inputs, and independent witness identity.

acceptance.then: Execute the absent-path fixture and verify its independent witness artifact.
acceptance.when: FR-1 absent-path rejection behavior is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use the absent-path selector with a target path that does not exist; the invocation must fail if invalid-input rejection is missing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Provide an isolated absent-path selector and independent verification of FR-1 invalid-input rejection.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep FR-1 path-validation results and error contract backward compatible; rollback only selector or verification wiring.

slice_hint.state_transition: valid baseline -> absent target path -> invalid-input rejection
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Absent-path invocation terminates with invalid-input rejection and independent witness recorded.
